meta.title: Quran & Noor Al-Bayan Academy
meta.description: Learn to read the Quran with Noor Al-Bayan, designed for non-Arabic speakers.

home.headline: Learn the Quran with Afaf Assem
home.sub: You’re here because you want to learn the Quran, and I’m here to help you achieve your goal, in sha’Allah.
home.videoCaption: Get to know the teacher and how classes are taught.
home.intro: You’re here because you want to learn the Quran, and I’m here to help you achieve your goal, in sha’Allah.
home.experience: I have four years of experience teaching the Quran to non-Arabic speakers, and I’ve worked with different Quran academies and students of various ages and backgrounds.
home.credentials: Alhamdulillah, I hold an Ijaza in the recitation of Imam ‘Asim through both Hafs and Shu‘bah, and an Ijaza in Al-Jazariyyah. I’ve also completed two specialized diplomas in Quran teacher training, along with several courses in Tajweed and Islamic Studies.
home.classes: In my classes, you can learn Quran reading and memorization, the Foundation Course with Noor Al-Bayan, Basic and Advanced Tajweed, Quranic Arabic, and Islamic Studies, in sha’Allah.
home.goal: My goal is to make learning the Quran easy, comfortable, and suitable for each student’s level and needs. I’m passionate about helping my students overcome their difficulties and become more confident in their recitation.
home.trialBody: Send a WhatsApp message to reserve a trial session. We’ll match the class to your level, age, and goals.
home.trialNote: Open WhatsApp, introduce yourself, and tell us what you’d like to learn.

programs.title: Learning path
programs.noorBody: Arabic letters, forms, vowels, and connected reading until the student can open the Mushaf.
programs.quranBody: Correct recitation, tajweed foundations, fluency, memorization, and revision.

isolatedLesson.title: Isolated letters
isolatedLesson.intro: Explore each letter’s shape and name, then practise recognizing the number of dots.
isolatedLesson.tip: Pronunciation is shown as text only. No audio is played.
isolatedLesson.alifGuide: Similar to the A sound in Apple.
isolatedLesson.baShape: It looks like a plate with one dot below it.
isolatedLesson.baGuide: Similar to the B sound in Ball.
isolatedLesson.taShape: It looks like a plate with two dots above it.
isolatedLesson.taGuide: Similar to the T sound in Ten.
isolatedLesson.thaShape: It looks like a plate with three dots above it.
isolatedLesson.thaGuide: Similar to the Th sound in Three.
isolatedLesson.question: How many dots can you see?
isolatedLesson.wordwallHint: An extra review activity for these four letters opens on Wordwall.
isolatedLesson.alifNote: The hamza above alif is a sign, not a dot of the letter.
